scenarios.name: Hide and restore a panel while its unpinned expansion is open

scenario_steps.name: the full 3D Model ribbon is docked at the top
the Modify panel is visible with its additional command area open and unpinned
the user opens the ribbon panel selector
the selector and the Modify additional commands are visible together
the user clears Modify in the panel selector
Modify is unchecked and its main panel and additional commands are hidden
a small Modify title strip with a pin remains visible beneath the ribbon
the user selects Modify in the panel selector
Modify is checked and its main panel and additional commands are visible again
